summary.intent: Win the Lio 'Keep the Line Running' hackathon challenge for Soony by analyzing the confidential data drops, then building a general recheck-and-act agent product (poller, extraction, deterministic recompute, supplier emails, approvals) and handing it in by Sunday 12:00.
summary.outcome: Found the hidden Collector's/Standard launch shortfalls (80,000 art book overbooking, failed statue lot, frozen shipments, sleeve revision conflict, new 14:37 drop) and built a working web app (Today, Launch, routines, sign-off loop, confirmed-orders-as-inbound, role entry) with supplier emails sent and replies handled. Pushed jonas/today-flow at ae1f95d, with the README rewritten, logo changed to ink and an outbox lost-update race fixed; the Launch-for-Maren change was still being built.

repo: Confidential portal data lives in gitignored data/ (raw, drops, notes, img); .env holds SOONY_PORTAL_TOKEN and .env.example is committed with an empty token.

The portal API has only GET /api/v1/files, /files/{path} and /archive.zip; there are no webhooks or notifications, and files can be replaced under the same name, so polling must compare SHA-256 checksums rather than filenames.
Team workflow files CLAUDE.md and PROGRESS.md exist; tasks are claimed with a 'Now' line in PROGRESS.md. Entire hooks only create checkpoints when repo files change.

Backend is Python (src/ask_soony, uv run pytest, ruff) with a React/Vite frontend in web/ (tsc, npm run build). Frontend rebuilds into web/dist but the backend server must be restarted to pick up Python changes.
Proposals prepared by routines must expire when their case is decided, and be deduped across routines, otherwise approving them fails with 'not an open card'.

Push notifications go to every subscribed device (no per-person routing), and ASK_TEAMS_WEBHOOK is empty so Teams delivery doesn't work yet. Internal messages and escalations were only recorded until the sign-off loop was added.
ASK_SIGNOFF_SIMULATE=<seconds> auto-approves a passed-on case after that delay, labelled 'simulated for the demo', off by default.

code.finding: A decided case open in the view also marked the first 'Needs you' row as selected, which made the left list scroll back to the top. The case list is now expandable, sticky and self-scrolling, and a 'Ready for your OK' group is grouped per routine.

One-time-token /ok/<token> approval page for escalations and internal notify messages. Approve runs the chosen option through api.approve with via='signoff' and works at most once per link. basic_auth.py lets valid links through without a password.
Routine diagram is rendered as n8n-style nodes: When, one 'Only if' node with the numbered condition list and funnel counts, and one node per Then step. Connectors run only between nodes.

friction: Portal token was empty at the start, blocking data access until the user pasted it.

Teams webhook missing, so Hamburg questions only reached push-subscribed phones. Internal messages and escalations (collect the container, escalate to Maren) went nowhere while the UI claimed 'DC site lead has it now'.

Stale prepared steps made 'Do all 4' fail with 'not an open card'. A duplicate 'Ask Hamburg to count book stock' routine created double proposals.

PackRight received extra rev C requests after already saying it was not possible, and the approval record from 07:58 was lost to an outbox lost-update race that had to be restored from the Sent folder.
Supplier replies cannot save the Standard edition: nobody reachable by email can move container NHSU4471921, and the tracker only says 'RP: call terminal'.
The Claude Docs artifact was initially redundant with the HTML page, so the user asked for several rework rounds on question format and artifact type.
